parsed.faithful: Steel tempered to the degree fit for watch Springs acquires a strong magnetism which it exhibits immediately on the removal of the magnet. But it diffipates very fast; and, in a very few minutes, it is reduced to less than one half of its strength while in contact with the magnet, and not two thirds of what it was immediately on removal from it. It continues to diffipate for former days, though the bar be kept with care; but the diffusion diminishes at, and in the near at, half over third of its greatest power for any length of time, unless carefully kept or injudiciously treated.
parsed.modern: Steel tempered to the degree fit for watch springs acquires a strong magnetism which it exhibits immediately on the removal of the magnet. But it dissipates very fast; and, in a very few minutes, it is reduced to less than one half of its strength while in contact with the magnet, and not two thirds of what it was immediately on removal from it. It continues to dissipate for former days, though the bar be kept with care; but the diffusion diminishes at, and in the near at, half over third of its greatest power for any length of time, unless carefully kept or injudiciously treated.
